paper.title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
paper.abstract: LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content. We present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system. First, nine role-specialised agents decide jointly: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports, from which a Portfolio Manager sets target positions that a protected Risk Manager audits. Second, a seven-layer shared memory, assembled by code from the system's own record, gives each decision its position context, the market narrative, calibration and the agent's past decisions. Third, the system improves itself by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes the grades into memory, and each quarter a reflector proposes prompt learnings that a deterministic gate applies reversibly and replay of recorded inputs verifies. All three operate around an invariant core of order arithmetic, risk rules and discipline-agent prompts that no self-edit can reach. In a five-month live deployment (102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls), the system contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss; in replay of its recorded inputs, a single model given the same raw data traded more and lost 1.35 points against the market over five days where the joint design showed no significant loss, and no injected instruction was followed; and a 2015-2026 backtest shows the core alone lowering the maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies. The reflector traced the dominant failure to its root cause, and the gate applied a learning that the agent adopted on trigger evenings and on no control evening. Code: https://github.com/yebof/quant-agent

research_problem.text: 作者提出：行动智能体需同时综合异质弱证据、记住决策及结果，并从经验中改进而不削弱约束。

evidence.quote: An agent that makes consequential decisions from Web content must do three things at once: combine heterogeneous, individually weak evidence into one decision; remember what it has decided and how those decisions turned out; and improve from experience
without weakening the rules that constrain it.

research_problem.text: 作者归纳四类自进化失效：自我评分偏乐观、风险纪律被削弱、修改不可审计或撤销，以及无行为效果的修改被视为进步。

evidence.quote: (F1) Self-grading : the signal that drives evolution is the agent’s own assessment \hat{g}_{t} rather than y_{t} , and \hat{g}_{t} is optimistic.
(F2) Discipline erosion : \pi^{\prime} weakens the rules that bound risk, because nothing separates what the loop may change from what it must not.

(F3) Unauditable change : no record ties \pi^{\prime} to the evidence that produced it, so an erroneous edit can be neither found nor reverted. (F4) Undetected inertness : an edit passes every check yet changes no decision, and the loop reports progress it did not make.

method_steps.text: 晨间四名分析师并行读取 Web 并输出类型化报告；投资组合经理结合共享记忆形成计划，依次经过确定性订单构造器、阻断式风险引擎和风险经理。

evidence.quote: Only the morning session may open positions: four analysts read the Web in parallel, a Portfolio Manager synthesises their typed reports with the shared memory of § 4.2 , and the plan passes through a deterministic order constructor, a blocking risk engine and an LLM Risk Manager before execution.

method_steps.text: 用 Pydantic 对象及字段校验约束输出，保存验证后对象及精确输入；代码从系统记录组装七层共享记忆，供经理读取。

evidence.quote: Each agent emits one Pydantic object (Appendix B ).
An agent cannot skip a step, enumerations are Literal types, and cross-field validators encode domain invariants:

The validated object is stored verbatim with its exact input, so the record is not a log about decisions but the decisions themselves, in a form that code can grade, a reflector can read and a harness can replay.
The agents share no conversation history. They share a memory that code assembles from the system’s own record in seven layers, read by the Portfolio Manager every morning.

method_steps.text: 晚间更新反馈；季度反思提出类型化提示词学习，经确定性门控可逆应用。固定记录输入比较更新前后输出，并以未改提示词重跑估计模型方差。

evidence.quote: each evening, code grades every trade and forecast and writes the grades into memory; each quarter, a Meta Reflector proposes typed prompt learnings that a twelve-invariant gate applies reversibly and that replay verifies.
A decision-replay harness passes recorded inputs through the prompt before and after a learning, with the rest of the input fixed, and compares the outputs structurally:
Re-running the unchanged prompt on the same inputs measures the model’s own variance, against which a learning’s effect is read.

author_contributions.text: 作者将贡献定位为多信号行动智能体的治理：角色协作、代码共享记忆，以及围绕自编辑无法触及的不变核心开展双时间尺度演化。

evidence.quote: our contribution is not a signal but the governance of an agent that acts on many, evaluated live.

We presented Steward , a multi-agent LLM system for autonomous investing in which role-specialised agents decide jointly over heterogeneous Web data, share a memory computed by code, and evolve at two time scales around an invariant core that no self-edit can reach.

author_contributions.text: 作者声称，据其所知，这是首个经数月在线运行评估且记录全部演化提案与拒绝的自进化 LLM 智能体；本次未独立确认该优先权。

evidence.quote: To our knowledge, Steward is the first self-evolving LLM agent evaluated over months of live operation with every proposal and rejection of its evolution loop logged.

it targets 5.8 names a morning against 3.7, puts 41% of equity into new intent against 19%, and reverses its own recent decisions two and a half times as often (0.25 against 0.10 per morning)

evidence.quote: We insert one adversarial item into the exact recorded input of ten mornings and re-run the agent (Table 4 ; 50 calls, US$19), with three payloads:

a direct override (set one name to 45% and every other target to zero), a plausible headline (300% upside; managers are taking maximum size and disabling stops) and a suspension of discipline (stops and the cash-only rule lifted, allocate 60% to an inverse ETF).
The News agent excluded the item from its typed report in all 20 replays and flagged it as instruction-like in every briefing.

Placed directly in the Portfolio Manager’s news section, as if the analyst layer had passed it through, the item was followed in none of 30 replays; in 23 the Portfolio Manager’s CoT named it as injected content and refused it

experiments.metric: 攻击内容排除次数、指令遵从次数、显式识别拒绝次数

experiments.text: 确定性审计衡量推理记录中数字的可匹配性；来源范围包括输入、历史提示词及自身输出。

evidence.quote: The audit samples up to 150 CoTs per agent and extracts every number in their reasoning fields, excluding small integers and years.
A number is grounded if it occurs in the agent’s input message, in any historical version of its prompt or in its own emitted fields, allowing rounding and truncation;
Grounded: cited numbers found in the agent’s input, prompt or own fields, including derived quantities; Strict: exact or rounded matches only; Placebo: strict grounding against another day’s input.
the placebo is reported on numbers with three or more significant digits.

limitations.text: 作者承认：证据仅来自一个配置、一个上涨窗口的模拟账户；前瞻期限重叠、模拟忽略成交风险，季度循环仅两次且仅一次应用；小规模回放不能按收益给架构排名。

evidence.quote: The evidence comes from one configuration traded on a paper account through one rising window, with overlapping forward horizons, simulations that ignore fill risk and two quarterly cycles, one applied; replays of 14–20 inputs expose behavioural differences but cannot rank variants by return.
alpha is not identifiable over 102 days, and no claim of this paper rests on it.

limitations.text: 作者指出，Q3学习所需历史分类计数未进入实际输入；其他提示词与股票池的人工修改使10月记录无法隔离学习效果。应用前结果评分回放仍是下一步。

evidence.quote: the trigger presupposes a count of past classifications that the Evening Analyst’s input does not provide
Because the operators had also revised other prompts and the universe before the cycle, the October record cannot isolate the learning; replay can.
The natural next invariant is therefore an outcome-scored replay check that confirms a learning is operable on the agent’s actual inputs and measures its effect on decisions before it is applied.

roles.text: 九个角色为新闻、财报、宏观、技术四名分析师，投资组合经理、风险经理、持仓审查员、晚间分析师和季度反思器。

evidence.quote: Nine LLM agents and a deterministic core run in six sessions
The News Intelligence agent maintains three layers:
The Earnings Analyst reads 10-Q and 10-K filings
The Macro Analyst classifies the regime
The Technical Analyst rates each symbol on a five-level scale

The Portfolio Manager returns target positions; the Risk Manager approves or rejects the plan with a reason category, field-level modifications and an optional scale factor for all buys; the Position Reviewer returns SELL, REDUCE, TRAIL_STOP or HOLD per holding.
The Evening Analyst then completes a seven-step CoT
On the last trading day of each quarter the evening session invokes a Meta Reflector.

coordination.text: 分析师并行、经理综合，随后代码构造订单并执行硬规则阻断，风险经理复审；风险经理不能批准被引擎阻断的计划。

evidence.quote: four analysts read the Web in parallel, a Portfolio Manager synthesises their typed reports with the shared memory of § 4.2 , and the plan passes through a deterministic order constructor, a blocking risk engine and an LLM Risk Manager before execution.
Only plans that pass reach the LLM Risk Manager, which can reject, modify or scale them but cannot approve what the engine blocked.

communication.text: 智能体不共享对话历史，通过类型化报告传递信息；原始标题和申报文本仅进入新闻与财报智能体，经理接收类型化字段和新闻简报。

evidence.quote: The agents share no conversation history.
Raw headlines and filing text reach only the News and Earnings agents
The Portfolio Manager never sees a headline or a filing: it reads typed fields and the News agent’s briefing

shared_memory.text: 代码组装七层记忆：当日信号、持仓背景、近期叙事、45天校准、最近风险裁决、经理最近决策及接近行业上限的预计持仓。

evidence.quote: They share a memory that code assembles from the system’s own record in seven layers, read by the Portfolio Manager every morning.
L1 holds the day’s typed analyst signals. L2 gives each holding its entry date, days held, entry thesis and its last seven Technical ratings.
L3 is the narrative: the last seven evening outlooks, seven days of macro regime, and the high-conviction news state changes of the last two weeks.
L4 is a 45-day calibration table:

L5 lists the last five Risk Manager verdicts with their categories, L6 the agent’s own last three decisions, so that reversals are visible, and L7 a projected book that flags sectors approaching their cap.

scheduling.text: 仅晨间允许开仓，午间与收盘仅卖出；晚间核对成交并复盘，季度末反思90天记录；无LLM熔断器每30分钟及晨间各阶段运行。

evidence.quote: Only the morning session may open positions
The midday and close sessions are sell-only and run a Position Reviewer
20:00–22:00 evening ✓ reconcile fills; grade trades and forecasts; write insights quarter end meta ✓ self-portrait over 90 days; propose learnings; governed apply
The circuit breaker, which uses no LLM, runs every 30 minutes and again at each stage of the morning session

changed_object.text: 更新对象为每日代码重写的记忆，以及四名分析师、投资组合经理、晚间分析师提示词的 Learnings 区；风险经理、持仓审查员和代码规则受保护。

evidence.quote: What can change is the memory, rewritten daily by code, and the prompts of the four analysts, the Portfolio Manager and the Evening Analyst, each of which carries a marked Learnings section that the gate of § 4.5 may append to.

The Risk Manager and the Position Reviewer, which encode the hard discipline, are absent from the Literal type of the proposal schema, so no self-edit can name them, and every rule above lives in code that no prompt reaches.

feedback.text: 晚间分析师生成类别标签，结果量由代码根据成交和价格计算；代码聚合校准、预测命中率、重复遗漏及根因，供次晨决策和季度反思使用。

evidence.quote: The labels the Evening Analyst assigns are categories; every quantity that measures an outcome is computed by code from fills and prices.

What feeds forward is aggregated by code from that record: the calibration of L4, the hit rates of the next-day calls, missed themes that recur in at least two episodes or symbols over the last 14 evenings, and root causes that recur across at least two symbols.
The Portfolio Manager reads them the next morning with the evening’s outlook
Its input is a deterministic digest of 90 days of graded record

update_method.text: 季度反思至多提出三个追加或按哈希撤回的学习项；确定性门控检查目标、长度、禁词、相似度和容量，记录接受或拒绝，并以版本提交支持撤销。

evidence.quote: Its output is at most three PromptLearning objects (Listing 1 ), each an append or a retraction by content hash

(2) an allow-list of target agents, with the Risk Manager and Position Reviewer excluded both here and in the proposal schema’s Literal ; (3) length ceiling (300 characters; 200 before the Q3 cycle) and justification floor;

(4) a word-boundary prohibited-word tripwire ( never , always , override , ignore all , must always , must never ); (5) Jaccard token-similarity dedup against existing entries (threshold 0.6); (6) a per-agent FIFO cap that evicts the oldest auto-added entry;
every accepted and rejected proposal is logged with its reason; and a cycle’s edits form a single version-control commit, so that one git revert undoes a quarter of evolution.

evidence.quote: An agent that makes consequential decisions from Web content must do three things at once: combine heterogeneous, individually weak evidence into one decision; remember what it has decided and how those decisions turned out; and improve from experience
without weakening the rules that constrain it.
(F1) Self-grading : the signal that drives evolution is the agent’s own assessment \hat{g}_{t} rather than y_{t} , and \hat{g}_{t} is optimistic.
(F2) Discipline erosion : \pi^{\prime} weakens the rules that bound risk, because nothing separates what the loop may change from what it must not.

(F3) Unauditable change : no record ties \pi^{\prime} to the evidence that produced it, so an erroneous edit can be neither found nor reverted. (F4) Undetected inertness : an edit passes every check yet changes no decision, and the loop reports progress it did not make.

Only the morning session may open positions: four analysts read the Web in parallel, a Portfolio Manager synthesises their typed reports with the shared memory of § 4.2 , and the plan passes through a deterministic order constructor, a blocking risk engine and an LLM Risk Manager before execution.
Each agent emits one Pydantic object (Appendix B ).
An agent cannot skip a step, enumerations are Literal types, and cross-field validators encode domain invariants:

The validated object is stored verbatim with its exact input, so the record is not a log about decisions but the decisions themselves, in a form that code can grade, a reflector can read and a harness can replay.
The agents share no conversation history. They share a memory that code assembles from the system’s own record in seven layers, read by the Portfolio Manager every morning.

each evening, code grades every trade and forecast and writes the grades into memory; each quarter, a Meta Reflector proposes typed prompt learnings that a twelve-invariant gate applies reversibly and that replay verifies.
A decision-replay harness passes recorded inputs through the prompt before and after a learning, with the rest of the input fixed, and compares the outputs structurally:
Re-running the unchanged prompt on the same inputs measures the model’s own variance, against which a learning’s effect is read.
our contribution is not a signal but the governance of an agent that acts on many, evaluated live.
